verdict.rationale: Hatchet presents itself as an orchestrator for AI agents and durable workflows with automatic retries and durability. It has retry-policy docs and agent cookbooks (Support Agent, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK), and docs on exposing workflows as tools agents can invoke. However, the evidence never shows model and tool calls checkpointed as individual steps inside a dynamic loop. The founder also notes that workflow execution paths are declared ahead of time, so you can't try/catch a single task, which limits dynamic agent loops. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-step checkpointing and resume after a mid-run crash, support for dynamic (non-predeclared) agent loop steps, and hands-on corroboration of crash recovery.
